Representability failures return a concrete error: missing/aliased row index, unsupported rotation/scale, nonfinite/intermediate overflow, inconsistent anchors, coordinate/extents overflow. Do not silently truncate to BYTE/nibbles.

A valid complete result is immutable; cancellation before publish discards it. IPC layout is not changed in this round.

history_layout.normal_window: Empty begin=end=0,current=-1. Transaction begin increments current, sets end=current+1, caps window at4, and subtracts4 when begin>=4. Native modulo is signed; corrupt negative slots are dangerous.
history_layout.ordering: Undo removes group1 before recreating group0. Redo removes group0 before recreating group1. Both defer the old objects' destruction, so removed memory cannot be counted as already free.

blueprint_format.part_record: 4bytes: tableindexBYTE; byte1 bits0..2 Z-axis direction, bits3..5 Y-axis direction, bits6..7 variant; WORD2 XYZ4-bit coordinates plus mirrorX/Y/Z bits12/13/14, reservedbit15=0.
blueprint_format.order: All material anchors in grid linear order, then all decoration anchors. Colors follow exactly the same combined order.
blueprint_format.orientation: Codes+Y0,-Y1,+X2,-X3,+Z4,-Z5; exported orthonormal discrete matrix must reconstruct using native cross product. Native invalid orientation masks-1to7; the trainer must report it instead.
blueprint_format.coordinates: Anchor is computed from partposition + (abs(rotatedRawSize)-10)*(-0.5), then native float32 grid division/truncation. Let d begrid dimension,c=floor(d/2),m=minoccupied,M=maxoccupied; H=max(c-m,M-c+1), extent=2*H, exportedcoord=anchorcoord+H-c. Require1<=H<=7 and coordinates0..15, no masking loss. Verify occupancy and reconstruction remain equivalent.
blueprint_format.scale: The native format stores only signs ofXYZscale, not arbitrary scale magnitude or an arbitrary affine matrix; require representability and report unsupported data.
blueprint_format.title_note: The title area was previously unknown:52FDB0/52F8F0/52F900 confirm+144/+146. Zero title is a valid native state (52FDA0). Do not copy stale static-scratch text.
blueprint_format.compatibility: Part codes are row indices of the current parameter table, not global part IDs. Include parameter row mapping/digest in the sidecar. A file made with one mod's table may mean different parts under another.
